summary: F-4 Tighten repair: closed the inherited-field acceptance bypass in orchestration exact-field validators. ApprovedWork, approved nodes, PredictedTouchEvidence, and nested overlaps now require every accepted required/optional value to be an own data property (Object.hasOwn). Inherited Object.prototype values are rejected even when they satisfy type and content checks. Normal Object.prototype and null-prototype records continue to be accepted when fields are own. Added hostile inherited Gate-1, top-level evidence, and overlap tests proving rejection with no work persistence, scheduling decisions, or frozen-baseline mutation.
